rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality blastocyst with identifiable ICM, cohesive TE, large blastocoel, and thinned zona; appropriately notes uncertainty between 3AA and 4AA. Slight limitation from inferring details not fully verifiable on a single static image.

Strong integration of age, DOR/AMH, oocyte yield, BMI, endometrium, semen quality, and first-cycle status with embryo quality, clearly distinguishing embryo-level prognosis from cumulative retrieval-level prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions well supported by morphology and patient factors. Probability ranges are explained clearly and caveated appropriately for an untested embryo.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice and Gardner criteria, including eSET, luteal support, and nuanced PGT-A discussion. Minor limitation is some generalized advice without explicit mention of clinic-specific protocol dependence.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including eSET, progesterone optimization, lifestyle guidance, stimulation review, trigger considerations, and when to revisit PGT-A or uterine evaluation.
